study type: Retrospective analysis of prospectively collected data
cohort: All hospitalizations for births ≥22 weeks of gestation in France from January to June 2020
finding: Pregnant women with COVID-19 had a higher frequency of maternal morbidities and adverse obstetrical outcomes compared to pregnant women without COVID-19.
mod_finding: Pregnant women diagnosed with COVID-19 had a higher rate of Cesarean section deliveries than pregnant women without a COVID-19 diagnosis.
